notes_for_editor: Bare list line only, with no registry number, agency or status. Searches and the cached Georgia directories (Forest Lookouts, NHLR, Former Lookout Sites) found nothing about this tower. The story is about 45 words, far below the roughly 120-word norm; hold it if the page would look empty. The list does not state its elevation unit, so the story gives 1,393 with no unit and no metric conversion. The NHLR Georgia list includes Brogdon Hill (Gordon) Lookout (US 1238, GA 22), but the list's Brogdon Hill point (GA223, 34.54209, -84.92789) is about 20 km west of this one, so it is a different site and was not used.
